verdict.rationale: Graphite documents a codebase-aware AI review agent (graphite-docs-16), and its Chat can find related files, explain dependencies and pull context from other PRs (graphite-docs-15, graphite-docs-21). It also tracks PRs across many repos with filters (graphite-docs-11) and breaks large changes into reviewable stacks (graphite-docs-25, graphite-docs-30). None of this shows the reviewer reasoning coherently about a change that spans several repositories, and nothing shows how it handles large monorepos. Missing for 10: explicit cross-repository change understanding, coherent review of a single change spanning multiple repos, documented large-monorepo scale handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
